notes.title: Dev Diary #4 - A Peek at the Next Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Mages!

We're back with another Dev Diary!

First to know, instead of releasing one large update, we've decided to break these features (that we have teased in our latest blog) into multiple patches/updates. We are currently working on three (and possibly four) key features that will be added to Revenge of the Mage soon: Steam Achievements, the Talent System, Voice Acting (and Leaderboards). These features are designed to enhance long-term goals and player progression, as well as to elevate the game's storytelling.  


Achievements

We are currently testing Steam Achievements to give you specific milestones to work toward. We’ve designed a variety of achievements that track different accomplishments in the game. Some will be tied to general progression, while others are designed for specific, challenging tasks.

These achievements are intended to add a new layer of goals and replayability for those who enjoy chasing them. As a starting point, we have planned a specific list of achievements. Here are some of the Achievements to give you an idea.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8d407f762f5d3daa360c7204c9d291ca33009878.png"]


But over time, we want to expand the list bit by bit. We believe this will be especially fun for the Achievement Hunters out there to come back and claim them.


The Talent System

To address the desire for more lasting progression between runs, we are adding another feature to our meta-progression system: The Ancestral Talent Board, which we had mentioned in our second blog.

This is a well-known skill tree where you can spend your skill points to permanently improve your character. You'll gain these points when you level up (yeah, big surprise :P). The talents will offer a range of upgrades, from increasing your core stats to unlocking new passive abilities or modifying existing ones. It's still under heavy construction, but you can see two versions of the concept design for the Ancestral Talent Board here. And yes, there are Ascendency nodes at the top of the second concept ;)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/008aee277a431116f4adc19c4a077be38235cfcd.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/bbe7e43634a3577d47a8e94608ea032fdf7366c4.png"]
We are going back and forth on these concepts and the system itself while testing to find out what would be the best fit for Revenge of the Mage. Once a decision is made, we'll provide more details about how this feature will be introduced later. But eventually, this system is going to be a designed to provide a tangible sense of growth and a reward for your time spent playing, regardless of how far you get in a single run. The choices you make in the Talent System will allow you to customize your build over time, offering new strategic options for future runs. 


Voice Acting

To truly bring their personalities to life, we're adding voice acting for the player character and the Wizard Cat. This is just the beginning of our voiced characters feature for Revenge of the Mage, designed to elevate the game's storytelling and humor and help you get to know these two heroes on a whole new level. 


Leaderboards

For those of you who love a good competition, we are looking to include Leaderboards in the next update. We'll use Steam's leaderboard infrastructure for this. The plan is to track a variety of metrics, such as your highest score in a run and your fastest time to defeat a boss. This feature is all about friendly competition and seeing how your skills stack up against other mages and your friends. We're planning to introduce several leaderboards to give everyone a chance to climb to the top, regardless of their preferred playstyle.


Optimization & Performance Issues
We are aware that some mages faced frame drops and stuttering, particularly in specific multiverses. There are also a couple of crash scenarios that we are investigating. We are aiming to address all of these by the next update.

That’s it for this diary— we’re incredibly excited for what’s ahead, and we’re thankful to have such a supportive and passionate community with us on this journey. As always, your feedback means everything, so keep it coming!  

Until next time; 

— The Revenge of the Mage DEV Team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png"]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1.175 is Live! & Announcement for the future.
notes.notes:
Greetings Mages!

We've added new cinematics and made some quality-of-life improvements. This patch also includes gameplay tweaks and bug fixes for a more magical experience.

Plans for the future
We’re excited for what’s ahead and will be sharing our plans for future updates soon, in the style of our previous Dev Diaries. Thank you so much for your patience and continued support, it means a lot to us!

       New Cinematics
Level Intro Cinematics New intro cinematics have been added for Cathedral, North, and Tokyo. These are designed to deepen the immersion and set the tone for each run.

Next up for cinematics: Boss Intro Cinematics for all multiverses!

Player Experience
Gem Crystal Visual: Added a glowing effect to Gem Crystals to make them stand out more.

Boss Health Bar: Adjusted boss health bar to make remaining health easier to understand.

Small Teleport Panel Adjustment: Added a scaling animation to the text below the gold recovery bar to better introduce the gold recovery mechanic.

Boss Objective Animation: A scaling animation now plays when a boss objective is active. This will be further enhanced to improve clarity for new players.

Bug Fixes
Boss Objective Marker: Fixed an issue where the boss objective marker wouldn't appear in some multiverses.

Ring of Thirst: The ring now deals the intended damage as described.


Happy casting!

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1.172 is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings Mages!

Since our first major update, we’ve made several quality-of-life improvements and gameplay adjustments based on your feedback. This patch focuses on refining mechanics, balancing spells, and enhancing the overall experience. Here’s what’s new:

Steam Cloud

 Integrated Steam Cloud: We've prioritized Steam Cloud integration based on community requests and moved it up in our roadmap. Now, our dear Mages can sync their saves seamlessly!
Before syncing Steam Cloud, we recommend backing up your files just in case. This will allow you to recover them if any errors occur with Steam Cloud. 

Save Files Location: AppData/Local/RevengeOfTheMage\Saved\SaveGames

Gameplay Changes

 Energy Detonation: We’ve received feedback about the ability and immediately revised it.


 Lowered the animation sound volume.
 Increased the effect area: 1.75m → 2.50m
 Increased the cooldown to balance the effect: 2s → 4s
 Distinct Power-ups: Power-ups now always spawn as distinct types, preventing duplicates.

 Trap Spawning: Traps no longer spawn beneath the player at the start of the Pyramid Boss Fight.

Bug Fixes

 Cathedral Enemies Stuck: Enemies no longer get stuck on one of the nails in the Cathedral Multiverse’s center area.

 Cathedral Nails: Thanks to a community report, we fixed one of the nails in the Cathedral Multiverse that dealt unintended damage.

 Teleport Back Locations: Thanks to another community report, we fixed an issue where players would get stuck when teleporting back to the surface from off the map. Teleport locations for the Tokyo and Cathedral Multiverses have been updated.


Optimization

 Forest Multiverse: To improve performance, we’ve temporarily removed towers and optimized enemies. In our internal tests though results may vary by system, this increased performance by an average of 20 FPS. This is not a permanent fix but will enhance the experience until a full solution is implemented.


Localization Fixes

 Fixes for All Languages: Since the Major Update we've revised localizations in all languages.


The Wizard Cat

 Audio: The cat now purrs when petted—voiced by one of the dev team’s own cats! 😺


We appreciate your feedback and hope you enjoy the changes! Let us know if you run into any issues.

Happy casting!

—The Dev Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

notes.title: Unleash The Storm Major Update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello Mages!

We’re thrilled to release our first major free update for Revenge of the Mage! This update introduces the brand-new Lightning Archetype, a Ring Crafting & Equipping system, a General Progression Level system, and plenty of gameplay improvements, balance tweaks, and bug fixes.

Dev Note: We invite you to test this major patch and share your thoughts on the new features. Two days after the update, we’ll begin adjusting costs and gameplay balance based on your feedback. In the meantime, we’ll keep you updated with Steam Announcements & Discussions. You can also reach us in a heartbeat :) on our Discord server! 

[hr][/hr]

Summary

For those who prefer a quick rundown, here’s what’s new!


 Pet the Wizard Cat! – Yes! As you requested, you can now pet the Wizard Cat! :)
 New Archetype: Lightning – Command the power of storms!
 New Combo Gauge System: Keep fighting to deal even more damage!
 New Crafting System: Start crafting powerful rings.
 General Progression Level System: Play more, progress more.
 Gameplay Changes: Scaling Difficulty tweaks, balance adjustments, and more.
 Tons of bug fixes: We’ve squashed a lot of them!


[hr][/hr]

Pet the Wizard Cat!

Do we even need to say more? :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/64ff0058ff968a4ec06e467f1fcca8529af40dca.gif

[hr][/hr]

Lightning Archetype

Our first (but definitely not the last!) additional Archetype has arrived – and it’s electrifying!
Unleash the raw power of lightning to strike down your foes with devastating energy-based attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/24edf3bc739c81b840d76db4b046596ec9a8c81a.gif

[hr][/hr]

New Combo Gauge System

Introducing the Combo Gauge System! Your primary ability damage now scales with your combo rank.
This means enemies will feel less like bullet sponges if you stay in combat and maintain your momentum—the longer you fight, the harder you hit!

Additionally, we’ve made some adjustments to enemy health pools for better balance.

[previewyoutube=FZoWBawbLc8;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

Crafting System

Crafting is finally here, starting with rings!

To craft and upgrade these unique magical accessories, follow these steps:


 Reach the required Progression Level to unlock them.
 Collect Gem Crystals scattered across the multiverse.
 Break Gem Crystals to obtain Gems.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/ca82b5cdb99cef1e94e8bc198fd26d8642fe1716.gif

 Use Gems and Gold to Craft or Upgrade a ring.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/f08c4505f88c3de0e3d6e209d479d94a84e5190b.gif

 Equip your rings and enjoy their special effects!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/d819614db04f0877de613b4c91e4e0713db25be8.gif

For example, let's look at two rings. These rings modify the Draw The Line and Holy Ground cards. Normally, these cards create zones that provide movement speed and healing. However, when the rings are worn, these zones transform into auras surrounding the mage. This effect allows mages to maintain their momentum in battle without being restricted to specific areas.

Ring of the Moonwalker for altering the Draw The Line Card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/1e762a754292616d6bb2401d24c29df80344c40a.gif

Ring of Medic for altering the Holy Ground Card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/7c86ada88cb4df4f90873c388e8336618d938148.gif


[hr][/hr]

General Progression Level System

To create a smoother and more rewarding experience, we’ve introduced the General Progression Level System.

Dev Note: For now, only Rings can be unlocked with this system, but in the future, many more features will be integrated into it.

For example, a player can increase their Progression Level to 10 if they play on Medium initial difficulty with consecutive Multiverse runs (Multiverse 1 > M2 > M3 > M4 > M5, then looping back to M1 and completing it successfully), which takes approximately 1 hour.

There is no XP penalty for Progression Level if the player dies.

For now, we believe this is a fair balance. Of course, this is not the final decision—we will continue refining these values based on your feedback, as we always have.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/321a2144247a05766036c72295d272f06214b36e.gif

We want every battle and upgrade to feel meaningful in the long run!

How do you level up? Just play! :)

[hr][/hr]

Gameplay Changes & Bug Fixes


 We made a significant change for how often Scaling Difficulty increases.
 Boss health pools have been reworked – Since difficulty scaling now applies, we’ve reduced their base health for better balance.
 Primary abilities of all Archetypes have been adjusted – This change is driven by the revised Permanent Upgrade Moar Powwa, which now grants +10 base damage per rank instead of +5. Additionally, auto-targeting abilities now deal slightly less damage to maintain balance with aim-required abilities.
 The new Combo Gauge System now boosts primary ability damage as your combo rank increases.
 Enemy Hit Outline: Reduced the duration of enemy hit outlines for a sharper hit response.
 Effects after Boss Defeat: Poison areas are now removed after the boss is defeated.
 AoE Ability Visuals: For AOE spells decal areas increased 30% to match better with collision area.
 Piercing Projectiles: Now piercing projectiles pierce through shields.
 Description Revisions: Revised ability descriptions to match their in-game representation.
 Gold to Recover: In the portal interaction window "Gold at Risk" has been changed to "Gold to Recover" for better clarity.
 Portal Locations in Safe Heaven: Swapped the locations of the Tokyo and Forest Portals in the HUB to match the unlock order.
 Pause Menu: Pause menu not showing when return to hub/menu or quit widgets closed with esc fixed.
 Chest Pickup SFX: Chest pickup sound not playing fix.
 Passive Spell Cards on Pause: Passive spell card animations now properly pause when the game is paused.
 Drone Health Bar: Fixed drone health bar position being too high.
 Enemy Outline: Enemy hit outlines now appear in the North and Tokyo multiverses.


[hr][/hr]

Language Support
Portuguese: Introduced Portuguese (Brazil) localization to make the game accessible for more mages.

[hr][/hr]

Also, we’ve updated our roadmap! Check it out here.

[hr][/hr]

We’re always grateful for your feedback and excited to see how these changes improve your experience. Stay tuned for more updates and as always let us know if you encounter any issues!

May the magic be with you!

-The Dev Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

Crash fixes
Addressed the most frequent crashes to improve overall stability. Please continue sending crash reports so we can resolve any remaining issues!

Gameplay Changes

 Gold Chests: Now automatically collected when approached—no need to interact.

Ability Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/51214d7bc782ca5a1727927ed98ebcfd4e15c18f.gif
(DEV Note: Cavill's iconic “arm reload”, that was fun to add lol)

Animation

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1.100 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Mages!

We’ve been working hard to implement your feedback and improve your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s included in the latest patch: 
Optimization

 Performance Optimizations: Optimized performance across all levels, spells, and character models to improve gameplay experience and reduce system load.

(DEV Note: We keep exploring the possibility of lowering the Minimum System Requirements without losing too much visual quality. In the future, we also aim to increase the overall visual quality as much as possible. This may take a few more patches to hit perfect performance.)

 FPS Limit: Increased the FPS limit to 200. (DEV Note: Community request)

UI/UX Improvements

 Increased the font size of card descriptions for easier readability.

Gameplay Adjustments

 Auto-Lock System: Auto-lock now prioritizes bosses. It also fixed an issue where auto-lock sometimes failed to target the Cathedral boss (Ashtur) and shield enemies. (DEV Note: Community request)

Control Settings

 Invert Mouse Update: The Invert mouse setting has been divided into horizontal and vertical. This is also added for the gamepad.
 Gamepad Magnetism Settings: Added gamepad magnetism strength and gamepad magnetism radius settings.

Bug Fixes

 Card Selection: Fixed an issue where the card selection screen would sometimes not appear.
 Mumadonna Boss (Ring Ability): Some rings previously failed to deal damage when moving away from the boss, but they now function as intended.
 Saving Control Settings: Fixed control settings not saving properly.
 DLSS: Fixed DLSS not functioning correctly.
 Level(North) Fix: Misplaced blockers removed.

Sound Updates

 SFX for Spell & Mage Unlock: Spell & Mage unlock SFXs added.

Language Support

 Added support for Russian and Chinese. (DEV Note: Please share any feedback for further improvement!)

Ability Updates

 Glacial Step and Fiery Charge Rework: These abilities have been reworked to allow players to pass through enemies during their use. (DEV Note: Community request)
 Meteor Storm: This ability can now also deal damage to airborne enemies. Ability’s radius reduced, 10m → 7m.
 Cosmic Storm: Ability’s radius reduced, 10m → 7m.
 Meteor Strike: Ability’s radius is increased, 5m → 7m.
 Inferno Beam: Movement speed penalty decreased, 60% → 30%. (DEV Note: Community request)

Card Updates

 Damage Area Increase Card: Now also affects the radius of Contagious Burn and Meteor Strike.
 Trick Reaper Card: Players now gain 5 seconds of invincibility upon activation.
 Obliterate: Players now gain 2 seconds of invincibility upon activation.
 Healing zone: Lv1→30%, Lv2→50%, Lv3→70% (Max 3 stack).                                                       
 Speed zone: Lv1→40%, Lv2→70% (Max 2 stack).    
Added probability-based spawning for Heal and Speed Zones
 Faster Recharge Stack Limit: Reduced card's stack limit to 2. 

We’re always grateful for your feedback and excited to see how these changes improve your experience. Stay tuned for more updates and as always let us know if you encounter any issues!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

Happy casting!

—The Dev Team

notes.title: New Patch is Cooking! & A Glimpse for Feature Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello, Mages!

We’ve been gathering tons of valuable feedback from you and are working hard to address the issues you’ve reported. The next patch is approximately two days away, may less! (Fingers crossed!)

We’re also updating our >>>Roadmap<<< and will continue to keep it as up-to-date as possible.

Improving Overall Performance
Performance has been the strongest area of feedback we’ve received. The upcoming patch will include a significant number of performance improvements. Of course, you can expect even more improvements in future planned updates as we optimize the game.

Crashes
While we’ve resolved and patched some crashes, occasional issues may still occur. We’re actively collecting your crash reports (so please hit that Send button!) and investigating the problems. Rest assured, we’re fully committed to addressing every crash in future updates.

What About the Next Patch?
We want to share details about what you can expect in the next patch! (DEV Note: These updates may be split into separate patches if needed.)

Optimization

Making improvements to optimize performance. We’re also exploring the possibility of lowering the Minimum System Requirements, but of course without losing too much visual quality. In the future, we also aim to increase the overall visual quality as much as possible. (DEV Note: This may take a few more patches to hit perfect performance.)
FSR support is one of the most frequently requested features and is on the way.


New Accessibility Features

 The Invert Mouse setting has been divided into separate horizontal and vertical options.
 Adding Invert Horizontal/Vertical settings for controllers.
 Adding settings for Gamepad Magnetism Strength and Gamepad Magnetism Radius.
 Adding more sound effects for Spell and Archetype Unlocks to improve UX.
 Adding bigger font sizes for card descriptions to improve UX. (DEV Note: This may slip to another patch, but bear with us!)


Localization
Russian and Chinese language support is on the way!

Changes & Balancing

 Reworked Glacial Step and Fiery Charge: These abilities can now pass through enemies during use.
 Reworked Meteor Storm: This ability now deals damage to airborne enemies as well.
 Reduced Meteor Storm radius from 10m to 7m. (DEV Note: Slightly nerfed.)
 Increased Meteor Strike radius from 5m to 7m. (DEV Note: Slightly buffed.)
 The Damage Area Increase card now also affects the radius of the Contagious Burn and Meteor Strike.


Bug Fixes

 Fixing an issue where key rebinds are not saved after exiting the game.
 Fixing the controller aim assist vertical issue.
 Fixing multiple ring abilities of the Mumadonna boss. Some rings are not dealing damage when moving away from the boss; they will now deal damage as intended.
 Fixing an issue where card selection sometimes does not appear.
 Fixing an issue with Arcane Missiles auto-lock not targeting shielded enemies.
 Fixing an issue where Morva the Defiler's projectile attacks bounce back even without The Mirror Mirror Card.


What’s Next? A Small Glimpse Into the Feature Updates!

Thank you all again for jumping in and slinging spells with us at the beginning of our Early Access journey with RotM!

Our team is working hard, day and night, to respond as quickly as possible to your feedback. Even though we’ve already planned a lot for RotM, your participation is what will make this game even better.

Even for a Early Access launch many find really easy and fast to complete the current game content (not necessarily unlocking everything, but generally speaking). Some players like this, but others don’t. So we’ve already started working on possible solutions to be able to balance the time and effort required to complete the game with the current content.

This might raise a question for many of you: Are we going to reset the current progress? For now, no—that’s not part of the plan.


 It's hard to see some bosses within all the chaos of combat, so we planned to add an indicator for the boss, so players may more easily track them. This feature probably will have a QoL setting in the options, for those who don't want to use it.
 When a player uses ALT+F4 or if the game crashes mid-run, players lose their hard-earned gold. We’re actively working on a solution to save your gold without breaking the high-risk, high-reward concept.
 We’ll bring more cards and permanent upgrades that can be combined with the Archetypes!
 Leaderboards, Steam Achievements, and Trading Cards are features we want to introduce as soon as possible. (And Cloud Save for Steam!)
 Deck-building is one of our priority features, so you’ll be able to choose your favorite cards and leave out the ones you don’t like.


You can find more details in our updated Roadmap.

We’d love to talk about RotM with you on our Discord, track your feedback and concerns, and hear your suggestions. So please, we encourage you to join our Discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and work to improve your RotM experience. Thank you for being part of this journey.

notes.title: Patch v.0.0.1.90 is Live
notes.notes:
Hello Mages!

We’ve gathered tons of valuable feedback from you and worked hard to address the issues.

Our >>>Roadmap<<< has been fully updated with many details and will continue to be updated as much as possible.

Here’s what’s included in the latest patch:

Bugs Fixes:

Cathedral Boss: Fixed the issue where players could take damage during the boss sequence. Also, fixed the issue where the cathedral boss could leave the arena and get stuck. (Test results were passed for this, but if it still occurs, please let us know.)
Music Overlap: Fixed the issue where regular music did not stop correctly when the Tokyo boss music began.
Kill Count Fix: Fixed the issue where kills near the edges of the Viking map did not count toward progress.
Enemy AI Tweaks: Fixed the issue where ranged enemies on the Viking map would wait outside their attack range.
UI Improvements: Fixed the issue where the welcome message stayed in the background after being closed in the main menu.
Brightness Display Issue: Fixed the wrong brightness values in the settings.

New Changes Based on Player Feedback:

- Horde Behavior: The horde will now automatically die after you kill the boss, just like when the boss is summoned.
- Trap Adjustments: Fixed the issue where traps could spawn under the player and immediately attack during the first boss intro sequence. Traps now start with a delay.
- Default Volume: The default volume setting in Options has been reduced from 100 to 50 for a better audio experience.
- Dash Ability: Dash air friction has been reduced from 1.3 to 0.52, allowing players to travel farther.

Optimizations:

- VFX optimizations have been made for Morva the Defiler's Nature Beam ability.

Minor Changes and Adjustments:

- Removed the light beam from the Madonna Statue in Egypt and Tokyo for now, as it was causing confusion for players. It will be added back in future updates when its purpose is finalized.
- Viking Map name has been changed to North.
- Travel banner images have been reworked.
- The small lake in Forest has been reworked to make it slightly shallower.
- For the second level (Cathedral), we’ve added back the missing trigger zone. If a player falls under the map, this will trigger an auto-teleport ability to bring you back into the map.
- Adjusted the stairs to reduce the chance of getting mantled when sliding at the start or end of stairs on the Egypt map.
- Made adjustments for some complex props to allow easier mantling (grappling). Some props are intentionally left challenging.
- Adjusted several props across maps: Some were relocated, and others were removed to reduce instances of players getting stuck while moving.
- Improved AI navigation and added more jump points for AI.
- Resolved issues with piercing abilities do not register some of the enemies.

Known Issues:

- Game Crash Issue: We’re aware of the crash issues some players have been experiencing and are actively investigating the problem. Rest assured, we’re working on a fix and will release a patch for this as soon as possible.
	
Also, we are aware of that optimization is the most frequently reported issue, and we are continuing to work on improving it.

notes.title: Patch is on the way!
notes.notes:
Hello Mages!

We have gathered lots of feedback, especially about the current bugs, and we are crushing them as fast as we can. As starters, here’s a sneak peek at what to expect in the next patch:

Bugs:

Cathedral Boss: Fix for where players could take damage during the boss sequence. Also, a fix for the issue where the cathedral boss could leave the arena and get stuck.
Music Overlap: Fix for the issue where regular music did not stop correctly when the Tokyo boss music began.
Kill Count Fix: Fix for the issue where kills near the edges of the Viking map did not count toward progress.
Enemy AI Tweaks: Fix for the issue where ranged enemies on the Viking map would wait outside their attack range.
UI Improvements: Fix for the issue where the welcome message stayed in the background after being closed in the main menu.
Brightness Display Issue: Fix for the wrong brightness values in the UI.

New Changes Based on Player Feedback:

Horde Behavior: The horde will now automatically die after you kill the boss, just like when the boss is summoned.
Trap Adjustments: A fix for the issue where traps could spawn under the player and immediately attack during the first boss intro sequence. Traps now start with a delay.
Default Volume: The default volume setting in Options has been reduced from 100 to 50 for a better audio experience.

Game Crash Issue: We’re aware of the crash issues some players have been experiencing and are actively investigating the problem. Rest assured, we’re working on a fix and will release a patch for this as soon as possible.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Stay tuned for the next patch!

notes.title: Thank you All! Release date is set!
notes.notes:
First of all, we'd like to thank everyone who participated in the testing of RotM. More than 300+ Mages slung spells, defeated Mummadonna and its minions dozens of times, loved some cards (and didn’t love others), and most importantly, provided us with useful input in the form of suggestions and tons of bugs to crush. We tried our best in a short and limited time to add or change many of the requests that came from you all. We’ve squashed a lot of bugs, but we all know there are probably still some crawling around.

Also, we intentionally did not fix some bugs or glitches to let you break the game and have fun with it. So, you’re still welcome to try going out of bounds on the maps, make some 'Any%' speed runs, or discover other interesting stuff. By the way, we’d love to watch you do these things—please send us your videos! Maybe we can even do some watch-and-comment sessions on your footage; that would be fun. 

In a few hours, we’ll be shutting down the playtest option. However, with the release of the Early Access version of RotM, we also plan to release a demo version at the same time. This way, you can give it one last try before making a purchase.

Please enjoy the adventure, and keep guiding us on this multiverse journey by sharing your valuable feedback!

Also you may notice Early Access Release date is set to 16 January!
